source: Unicode CLDR 48.0 plural rules, read through Intl.PluralRules in Node 26.12.1 (ICU 78.3, Unicode 17.0)
regenerate: node -e "const L='en fr de es pt it ja zh ko ar he ru pl uk cs tr nl fa ur hi'.split(' ');const o={};for(const l of L)o[l]=new Intl.PluralRules(l).resolvedOptions().pluralCategories;console.log(JSON.stringify(o))"
note: Keys are base language subtags. The script matches the base language of a tag such as fr-CA. A language absent from this table is reported as plural-rules-unknown, never guessed.
